payload.recallText: Joe Matson, and clara and her brother were in the house just as the mail came. They were speaking about Joe's baseball career, just as his mother came in the room with a pitcher of water as he swung and clara called out to him to watch out too late.  He received mail from Mabel saying that her and a man were coming to visit on the train. They also spoke about a contract with the baseball team and how he was on the team when they won the pennant. When joe went to the train the conductor said that they would not be coming, and joe was worried it was because of a wreck but it was really due to it being stalled because of the bad snow storm.
